# CONTRIBUTING

## HOW_TO_CONTRIBUTE

WE WELCOME CONTRIBUTIONS OF ALL KINDS: BUG REPORTS, FEATURE REQUESTS, DOCUMENTATION
IMPROVEMENTS, AND CODE CHANGES. PLEASE READ THESE GUIDELINES BEFORE SUBMITTING A
PULL REQUEST OR OPENING AN ISSUE.

## ISSUES

- CHECK EXISTING ISSUES BEFORE OPENING A NEW ONE TO AVOID DUPLICATES.
- USE THE APPROPRIATE ISSUE TEMPLATE (BUG REPORT OR FEATURE REQUEST).
- INCLUDE CLEAR STEPS TO REPRODUCE, EXPECTED BEHAVIOR, AND ACTUAL BEHAVIOR FOR BUGS.
- FOR FEATURE REQUESTS, DESCRIBE THE USE CASE AND PROPOSED SOLUTION.

## PULL_REQUESTS

1. FORK THE REPOSITORY AND CREATE A NEW BRANCH FROM `MAIN`.
2. MAKE YOUR CHANGES, INCLUDING TESTS IF APPLICABLE.
3. RUN `npm run lint` AND `npm test` TO ENSURE EVERYTHING PASSES.
4. RUN `npm run build` TO CONFIRM THE PACKAGE BUILDS SUCCESSFULLY.
5. SUBMIT A PULL REQUEST WITH A CLEAR DESCRIPTION OF THE CHANGES.
6. A MAINTAINER WILL REVIEW YOUR PR AND MAY REQUEST CHANGES.

## DEVELOPMENT_SETUP

```bash
npm install
npm run build      # tsup -> dist/cli.js
npm test           # vitest
npm run typecheck  # tsc --noEmit
npm run lint       # biome
```

## RELEASE_PROCESS

- CHANGES ARE RELEASED VIA CHANGESETS. ADD A CHANGESET FILE UNDER `.changeset/`
  DESCRIBING YOUR CHANGE AND THE SEMVER BUMP (PATCH/MINOR/MAJOR).
- THE GITHUB ACTIONS RELEASE WORKFLOW WILL CREATE A PR AND PUBLISH TO NPM.
- MANUAL RELEASES CAN BE TRIGGERED WITH `npm run release`.

## COMMIT_CONVENTIONS

- USE CONVENTIONAL COMMIT MESSAGES (E.G. `feat:`, `fix:`, `chore:`, `docs:`).
- THIS HELPS THE `wtf` TOOL ITSELF CLASSIFY ITS OWN HISTORY CORRECTLY.
